contract.description: Discover prediction markets, trade outcomes, and manage positions.
contract.name: World

tools.description: Buy a YES or NO World position from a granted Solana wallet. First verify the exact market title and YES/NO mint with world_get_markets; never substitute another market from the same event. Pass the outcome mint and an exact-in `size` in atomic USDC units, not a built transaction; PayBox pins the buyer and sender from the credential. If the signing window reports a region block, tell the user to turn off their VPN if they have one, then click "Check again" in the same window; never create a second request for that trade. Approval follows the grant: autonomous returns `pending_signature`, while approval-gated returns `pending_approval`. Poll `get_request` with the same `request_id` through `pending_confirmation` to terminal; never re-call this tool for that request.
tools.name: World: buy outcome

tools.description: Add to or reduce a World position from a granted Solana wallet. First verify the exact market title and YES/NO mint with world_get_markets; never substitute another market from the same event. Use `side="buy"` with `size` in atomic USDC units, or `side="sell"` with `size` in atomic outcome-token units; PayBox pins the owner and sender from the credential. If the signing window reports a region block, tell the user to turn off their VPN if they have one, then click "Check again" in the same window; never create a second request for that trade. Approval follows the grant: autonomous returns `pending_signature`, while approval-gated returns `pending_approval`. Poll `get_request` with the same `request_id` through `pending_confirmation` to terminal; never re-call this tool for that request.
tools.name: World: change position

tools.description: Map up to 200 SPL outcome-mint addresses to the World markets whose exact YES or NO mint matches. This is read-only and useful for identifying World tokens found in a wallet.
tools.name: World: filter outcome mints

tools.description: Get World events (each groups one or more markets) without moving funds. Pass `ticker` for one event, with its nested markets by default (returns each market's ticker, status, and YES/NO outcome mints); omit it to list events, paged with `cursor`. A listed page defaults to `status=active` (pass `status` explicitly to see initialized/determined/finalized instead) and is ordered by volume only within that page, so do not treat the first page as globally ranked or complete. Use `world_search` to find a ticker by free text first.
tools.name: World: get events

tools.description: Get World markets (single YES/NO questions) without moving funds. Pass `ticker` for one market; omit it to list markets, filtered by event and paged with `cursor`. A listed page defaults to `status=active` (pass `status` explicitly to see initialized/determined/finalized instead) and is ordered by volume only within that page, so do not treat the first page as globally ranked or complete. Use the returned tickers and outcome mints for orderbook, prices, or a trade.
tools.name: World: get markets

tools.description: Get a World market's YES/NO quote history by ticker between Unix-second `start_ts` and `end_ts`, with an optional supported sampling resolution. This is read-only and useful for showing how the market moved.
tools.name: World: market prices

tools.description: Get the best YES/NO bids and asks, sizes, slot, and timestamp for a World market. Pass a market ticker, or an outcome mint with `by_mint=true`. This is read-only; a null side means there is no live quote, such as after determination or finalization.
tools.name: World: orderbook

tools.description: List a Solana wallet's World prediction-market positions, classified. Read-only: no funds move, nothing is signed, no credential is touched. Its `items` and `total_usd` use the same outcome pricing as get_portfolio. `items` is the raw live balance feed, not the final position classification. For a previously known outcome mint missing from `items`, check `positions`, `settled`, `position_result`, and `coverage` before explaining it; `position_result` in either list is the official classification. If neither list contains it, or `coverage.history_available=false` / `coverage.trades_truncated=true` / `coverage.market_data_available=false` leaves the answer unresolved, use `world_filter_outcome_mints` with that exact mint. For this exact-mint fallback, only report won or lost when finalized `status`, `result`, and the mint's exact YES/NO side prove it; otherwise say unknown. Never infer sold, no balance, won, lost, or not-yet-indexed from absence alone. A WON position settles into CASH (the outcome token is burned at settlement), so a winner holds CASH rather than the outcome token; cash out by swapping CASH to USDC via `settlement_cash.cash_out` (request_swap). `settlement_cash` is top-level and separate from any position. `coverage` flags unavailable market/history data or truncated history. Use before world_change_position or world_redeem.
tools.name: World: positions

tools.description: Redeem a settled World outcome position from a granted Solana wallet. First call `world_positions`, then pass candidate `items[].tokenAddress` values to `world_filter_outcome_mints` and use the exact matched outcome mint; raw balances do not classify winners or guarantee a payout. Pass `size` in atomic outcome-token units. PayBox quotes that outcome token to USDC; when World has no route, it reports nothing to redeem. If the signing window reports a region block, tell the user to turn off their VPN if they have one, then click "Check again" in the same window; never create a second request for that trade. Approval follows the grant: autonomous returns `pending_signature`, while approval-gated returns `pending_approval`. Poll `get_request` with the same `request_id` through `pending_confirmation` to terminal; never re-call this tool for that request.
tools.name: World: redeem

tools.description: Free-text search over World events by title, subtitle, series, and category/tags — e.g. "bitcoin" matches ticker-symbol titles. Defaults to `status=active` (pass `status` explicitly to see initialized/determined/finalized instead). Returns matched events with their nested markets and outcome mints by default, so a hit is immediately usable for orderbook, prices, or a trade. This is read-only.
tools.name: World: search
